observations_recorded_at_seal.G2_HAS_ZERO_MARGIN_AT_THE_PILOT_GATE_FLO: The MC error table gives, at lambda=0.3 (exactly the pilot gate's fly/hold threshold): G1 5.6 sigma against a >=5 bar (+0.6 margin), G3 8.6 against >=5 (+3.6), and G2 3.0 against a >=3 bar — MARGIN EXACTLY ZERO. So if lambda_hat lands at or just above 0.3 and the flight proceeds, G2's registered verdict rests on the sigma model being exact rather than approximately right. This is not an objection and not a blocker — the pilot gate, the bars and the power table are all the arc owner's to set, and they are internally consistent. It is recorded because a gate whose power exactly equals its bar at the threshold that licenses flying is the one place where a small sigma-model error changes the verdict, and a future reader deserves to see it noted BEFORE the data rather than discovered after. >>> RESOLVED pre-GO by Amendment 1 (see amendment_1): pilot threshold 0.30 -> 0.35, bars untouched, G2 margin now +0.5.

observations_recorded_at_seal.POOL_DISCIPLINE_IS_NOW_STRUCTURAL: The pool-re-read rule I raised at the B4 seal appears here three times — in the budget header, in the budget note, and as kill condition 4 — and has been upgraded from a caveat to a submission gate ('any stage that would overdraw the pool is not submitted'). The ask (~300 QPU-s) EXCEEDS the pool at drafting (~283 s), and staging is precisely what makes that legitimate rather than an overdraw.

what_this_entry_asserts: The text at 1359ca0, sha256 d1702ef7..., is FROZEN as of this seal and pre-dates submission.
The four registered gates with their numeric bars and frozen values, the staged budget, the degradation order, the analysis, and the kill/no-fly conditions are fixed as recorded.

what_this_entry_does_NOT_assert: It does NOT assert the flight is approved — the Creator's GO was OUTSTANDING at seal time, and the ask is the largest of the H10 arc.
It does NOT assert the KA gate or the pilot gate have passed. Either can still refuse the flight, and lambda_hat < 0.15 is a hard NO-FLY.

It does NOT assert the pool can fund all four stages — it cannot at drafting (~300 QPU-s asked against ~283 s). Staging plus the per-submission pool re-read is what makes the ask legitimate; a stage that would overdraw is simply not submitted.
It does NOT assert anything about outcomes, nor that the registered gates are the RIGHT gates — only that they were fixed before the data existed.

amendment_3.what_the_fence_caught: The SS5.1 estimator lock REFUSED the first flight build (no valid constants exist, residual 0.64) BEFORE submission. Root cause: a transcription INVERSION in Whisper's own scout note — SS6.1 recorded footnote 18 as 'measurement moved to the left determines the winding distribution' when the paper states the opposite (left gives the SIZE distribution P(S); winding comes from the right). Adjacent-true at the citation level, faithfully implemented into circuits, and caught by the FENCE rather than by re-reading. Second, deeper find: Eq.107's clean two-run recipe rests on an EPR-only cancellation, so at finite beta the naive expectation sandwich measures the CONJUGATED correlator whose transform is not f(S).
amendment_3.the_new_meter: C(g) = <Psi| B_R e^{igV} A_L |Psi> via an ancilla HADAMARD TEST (Re from the plain test, Im with S-dagger). Certified on the exact TFD: equals sum_S f(S) e^{igS} at 2.1e-15. KA gate on the as-built pubs: circuit-vs-operator 1.7e-13, decode-vs-registered 1.5e-13, beta0 zero at 2e-16.

amendment_3.proposer_flagged_against_their_own_fligh: Whisper stated in advance (coordination#3542) that the interferometric circuit is ~1150 CX pre-routing, so lambda_hat projections at current Heron error rates land 0.05-0.25 — meaning the S0 pilot may legitimately return NO-FLY under the very 0.35 gate Amendment 1 installed. Announcing that your own amendment may kill your own flight, before flying it, is the strongest available signal that the recomputation was protocol-driven rather than margin-driven.

outcome.status: S0 PILOT -> NO-FLY. The pre-registered kill condition fired; the staged program did NOT proceed. Flight record appended to the prereg at quantum@8b333d0.
outcome.measured: lambda_hat = 0.026 +/- 0.017 (|C0| = 0.017 against a registered 0.668) — the signal is 1.5 sigma from zero, fully drowned.
outcome.predicted_before_landing: ~0.02, from 1871 transpiled 2q gates x 0.22% chain error (Whisper, on the record pre-landing). Measured 0.026 +/- 0.017 — the projection verified INSIDE its own error bar.
outcome.WHICH_GATE_ACTUALLY_FIRED_and_it_was_not: THE ORIGINAL SPEC'S HARD NO-FLY FLOOR (lambda_hat < 0.15), not the 0.35 threshold my Amendment-1 observation installed. At 0.026 the flight would have been refused identically under the ORIGINAL pre-registration. My amendment neither caused nor contributed to this outcome, and recording otherwise would credit a change that did not decide anything. The zero-margin fix mattered for the case where lambda landed NEAR 0.3; lambda landed nowhere near it.
outcome.what_the_negative_establishes: A real hardware answer, not an absence of one: current Heron error rates cannot carry a 13-qubit interferometric winding measurement at this compile depth. The gap is quantified at ~4x — lambda 0.35 needs <=~475 2q gates at 0.22% chain error, and this compiled to 1871.
outcome.G1_G4_never_evaluated: BY DESIGN. The staging exists precisely so the registered verdict is never reached on underpowered data. Not a shortfall, and explicitly not an INCOMPLETE verdict — the pilot gate ran before the gated stages, which is the order the spec froze.
outcome.cost_of_the_answer: 12 QPU-s to decline a ~300 QPU-s program. The instrument protected the pool by a factor of ~25, which is the entire economic case for a staged pilot.
outcome.redesign_path_recorded_not_taken: The conjugated-correlator meter (the 13-bin object characterised in the Amendment-3 analysis) needs NO ancilla and ~700 fewer gates, and on an N=4 scrambler plausibly reaches lambda 0.3-0.4. Whisper states it re-enters at SCOUT + PREREG, not by amendment — a new instrument is not an amendment to an old one.

HOW_TO_VERIFY_THIS_SEAL.why_prefix_bound: SEALS ARE PREFIX-BOUND, not whole-file. Flight records and outcomes get APPENDED to these preregs after sealing (correctly — an append preserves the registered criteria and the change history stays legible in one artifact). But that means a naive `sha256sum <file>` MISMATCHES a seal that was perfectly honoured, and the reader has to redo forensics to learn nothing is wrong. Found by Uhura ratifying H10-C2 from the raw job (general#3640). The seal has ALWAYS been over the first N bytes; this field just makes that explicit and mechanically checkable instead of leaving it implicit.
